criteria.name: Mission concept and rationale — What will it do, who are the users, why is it needed?
criteria.reasoning: Clear goal, four quantified objectives, explicit Australian benefit, and named users with needs mapped to objectives. Well referenced to literature.

evidence.quote: Give reef managers direct, repeatable observations of coral colour over the whole Great Barrier Reef

criteria.name: Project plan — How you plan to complete the assignment, including either a Gantt chart or a timetable and information sources you plan to use
criteria.reasoning: Detailed Gantt to Week 10 with task logic explained, four risks with triggers/responses, float, and sourced table of information uses. Fully fits mission narrative.

evidence.quote: Week 10 is float as well as editing time: no new design work is planned in it

criteria.name: Preliminary progress — Technical content and evidence of sufficient work done to date
criteria.reasoning: Correct SSO hand calcs for period, orbits/day, inclination and swath with interpretation identifying coverage trade. STK tutorials done and scenario started, on track.

criteria.name: Report presentation
criteria.reasoning: Logical structure, clear writing, consistently labelled tables and Gantt, in-text citations matching reference list with proper details.

overall: Strong Australia-focused bleaching mission with quantified requirements, robust contingent plan, and correct preliminary orbital analysis guiding next design trades.

feedback.summary: Well done — you set out a strong Australia-focused reef bleaching mission with quantified requirements, a robust contingent plan to Week 10, and correct preliminary SSO analysis that clearly guides your next trades.
next_steps: Keep your four quantified objectives linked to reef-manager needs as you flow them into full requirements in Part 2.
Protect your Week 10 float and use your risk triggers to manage STK and payload sizing delays.
Extend your T = 2π√(a³/μ) coverage work into revisit and swath trades with interpreted STK outputs.

criteria.C1: You described a clear goal to give reef managers direct, repeatable observations in your Mission Concept & Rationale, with four quantified objectives and users mapped to needs. To stay at Accomplished, keep that explicit user-need trace and literature support in the full design.
criteria.C2: You built a detailed Gantt to Week 10 with task logic, float and four risks with triggers in your Project Plan. To stay at Accomplished, keep showing why the sequence fits your bleaching narrative and how sources will be used.
criteria.C3: You calculated period, orbits/day, inclination and swath using T = 2π√(a³/μ) in Preliminary Progress and identified the coverage trade. To stay at Accomplished, keep adding brief interpreted results that stay on track for completion.
criteria.C4: You used a clear logical structure with well-written text, consistently labelled tables and Gantt, and matching citations. To stay at Accomplished, keep that consistent formatting and clear graphical presentation through the final report.
